India has invited Pakistan’s National Heritage and Culture Minister, Aurangzeb Khan Khichi, to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation’s Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. The invitation comes amid strained bilateral ties following the Pahalgam terror attack and Operation Sindoor. What is the significance of this move, and could it signal a change in engagement?
